gate0._readme: Per document, chunks vs. the original file (pipeline/validator.py run_gate0). Ratios use the original text before header/footer removal.

lite._readme: track=lite: every tb_doc_chunks row goes into the Gemini context (no search, no embeddings). Above the limit the answer stops.

wiki_extraction._readme: pipeline/extract_wiki.py: each entity / concept keeps a verbatim quote of at most this length from its source chunk.

lite.label: Track 1 · Lite (Unstructured Wiki Only)
lite.description: 비정형 가이드·약관 문서 중심 환경 — Stage 1(자산·CQ) → Stage 2(3-Layer 위키·시맨틱 그래프) → Stage 4(에이전트·MCP) 빠른 구동 (물리 Property Graph 생략)

standard.label: Track 2 · Standard (Structured DW + Rules)
standard.description: 정형 DW + 비정형 위키 + Property Graph 결합 환경 — Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Stage 3(BigQuery Property Graph) → Stage 4(에이전트·MCP)

full.label: Track 3 · Full-Stack (Hybrid Wiki + Property Graph)
full.description: Stage 1~5 전주기 통합 — 3-Layer 위키 + BigQuery Property Graph + MCP 8종·에이전트 + 4계층 리니지·경계값 벤치마크(10×5)

bigquery.label: BigQuery Property Graph (ISO SQL:2023)

spanner.recommended_for: DDL 생성 지원 (`data/output/create_spanner_graph.sql`, 런타임 쿼리는 BigQuery Graph 사용)
